phases.objective: Prove one bounded Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint and a read-only metadata contract without relying on ChatGPT selection behavior.
phases.entrypoint: MCP Inspector against a development /mcp endpoint
phases.terminal_outcome: Initialization, tools/list, and representative read calls pass with correct schemas, annotations, errors, and metadata fingerprint.
assertions: The endpoint uses the supported MCP transport rather than split public REST routes.
All exposed phase-1 tools are proven read-only.
No query-string secret is required by the new endpoint.
Results are bounded and contain no secrets.

phases.objective: Connect the endpoint in ChatGPT developer mode and validate focused tool selection for supported read-only goals.
phases.terminal_outcome: Supported prompts select the correct tool and unsupported or write prompts do not cause mutation.
assertions: ChatGPT discovers the same catalog fingerprint as source and Inspector.
Correct tool selection meets the agreed threshold.
Unsupported requests have safe no-call behavior.
The plugin works without custom UI.

phases.objective: Prove OAuth 2.1 account linking, resource-bound tokens, current membership resolution, and tenant-safe denial.
phases.entrypoint: Protected read tool invoked from ChatGPT
phases.terminal_outcome: Authorized resources are readable and every wrong-resource, wrong-scope, revoked, or cross-tenant attempt fails closed.
assertions: Protected-resource and authorization-server discovery work.
Authorization code plus PKCE S256 works.
Wrong issuer, audience/resource, scope, signature, expiry, and revocation are rejected.
Cross-tenant and cross-Brand leakage is zero.
Revocation takes effect within the operational SLA.

phases.objective: Enable a small reviewed set of write tools with capability, policy, confirmation, idempotency, operation status, readback, and compensation.
phases.terminal_outcome: Each accepted request produces at most one governed side effect and an authoritative operation/readback result.
assertions: Confirmation is bound to principal, tool, target, intent, and expiry.
Authorization is rechecked immediately before dispatch.
Unknown outcomes are reconciled before retry.
Annotations match actual external and destructive behavior.
Each tool can be disabled independently.

phases.objective: Submit, approve, explicitly publish, monitor, and maintain one production plugin version with exact reviewed metadata.
phases.terminal_outcome: An approved version is published only after release authorization and production parity, with rollback and revocation proven.
assertions: Publisher identity and submission permissions are verified.
Privacy, terms, test access, listing, and release notes are complete.
Source, runtime, package, scan, approved, and published fingerprints match.
Publishing is a separate explicit action after approval.
Later metadata changes use a new reviewed version.
